Open Casting Call!

**CU Denver senior thesis film**

**Title:***** ****NO SAINTS*

**Genre: **Supernatural / Drama

**Logline: **An angel confronts a murderer.

**Characters:**

Lucy: 25-40 F

Civil war has come upon America again, and Lucy’s brother is drafted, leaving her to care for his two children. She’s educated and capable, and was meant for something more than this– but what other option is there?

A month ago, she discovered an enemy trooper hiding in the barn, and killed him in a panic. She pushes this secret deep down, but the guilt is eating her alive.

Soldier/Angel: 25-40 M

An angel, sent from Heaven to roam the Earth and collect confessions from sinners. He’s cold and calculating, and has no sympathy for the people he visits. What does it matter, as long as the job gets done? 

Monica: 15-18 F

Lucy’s niece, old enough to want to know more about the war and what she can do to help the family, to Lucy’s chagrin. 

Corey: 5-10 M

Lucy’s nephew, observant beyond his years. He doesn’t speak, expressing himself through his drawings instead. 

**Compensation:** Compensation for gas, meals, film credit, film copy

**Audition Information:** 

Please fill out the form below! Callbacks will be held in person, scheduled at a time that works for you. 

[Self-Tape Form](https://forms.gle/DWUHDLsoNA1sJPLw9) 

**Shoot Dates: **The goal is late October-early November, depending on everyone's schedules. 4 days for Lucy and the Soldier, likely only 2 days for the kids.

**Shooting Locations: **A cabin in Idaho Springs, and one other location TBD

If you have any questions whatsoever, please email [eloradodrill@gmail.com](mailto:eloradodrill@gmail.com). We’d love to work with you!

**CASTING CALL**

**Title: **Take Me to Ithaca

**Genre: **Comedy, Action, Road-trip

**Log line:**

A darkly funny road-trip crime story about a hitman who wants out—and the unlikely friendship that gets in his way.

**Contact Info**: [Sawyer.macres@gmail.com](mailto:Sawyer.macres@gmail.com)

**Production Type: **Indie

**Run Time: **Feature Film

**Compensation: **Paid (Day Players) / Stipend (Extras) Copy, Credit

**Dates: October / November (Weekends)**

**Location: Denver / Loveland, CO**

**Union Status: **non-union

*****Most roles have been filled for this project, but still casting for the following:**

**Crystal (Female) (20-30s)  (Day Player): **

A prostitute drifting through the world.

**Anna (Female) (10-14) (Day Player):**

The cello-playing niece of Charlie, a mobster who runs an underground crime syndicate. Anna’s goal is to play a perfect recital for her uncle + family but caves under the pressure and ends up botching the solo. Ideally looking for a cello player or someone who could “act” like they do.

**Anna’s Mother ( Female) (40’s) (Extra):**

Part of a mob family.

**Anna’s Father ( Male) (40’s) (Extra)**

Part of the mob family.

**8 - 10 Mobster Bodyguards (Male) (Extras)**

Tough, no-nonsense hitmen and mobsters.

**3 Waitresses (20’s) (Female) (Extras):**

Mexican-American waitresses that work at their dad’s restaurant. Bonus points for the ability to blow a bubble with chewing gum.

**Extras, Misc (Extras):**

We have scenes we’re looking to fill with extras, so if you’re interested in being on a film set, please reach out!

Audition Information: please send headshots, resume and/or reel to the email above.

topComments.text: Just commenting that Sawyer is awesome to work with! 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽￼

I'm a casting researcher from Manchester & I’m working with Stark Casting- looking for diverse UK based women aged 25-35 for a bodywash campaign for a well known beauty brand 🕊️

Must NOT be a model/ actor / influencer as it’s part of the brands ethos that they only use NON PROFESSIONALS in all their advertising 🩶

This is a very well paid opportunity! I can send more info & the brand etc via DM <33
Dates needed are between beginning- mid Oct 2026 in LONDON.

Give me a message here or on Instagram @romeycasting if you or someone you know fit the brief! If for some reason you can’t reach me- you can always email me too at romeycasting@gmail.com 
Feel free to share 🫶🏼

topComments.text: Looking for non actors on an acting casting call page is probably not the most sound method to find non actors..
Sick of these non model, actor, influencer castings as all are just trying to make a living. Should push back on the brand to say no reality tv stars only.

THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER : SEASON 1 : COMIC BOOK STYLE TV SERIES CONCEPT ART : THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER : THE TV SERIES PITCH DECK NOW IN DEVELOPMENT : PITCH DECK CONCEPT ART PREVIEW : SEEKING BUYER TO EXECUTIVE PRODUCE LIVE - ACTION TV SERIES.  

THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER TV SHOW SYNOPSIS : Having recently been Released from Prison, TERRANCE SMITH, A Multi - Millionaire Masked Vigilante, works undercover to hunt Crime Bosses In Atlanta’s Human Trafficking Industry only to confront his own inner demons and meet fellow Allies along the way who will ultimately aid him on his journey to bring Justice to The Streets Of Atlanta.

KNIGHT WARRIOR Created By April Wynn - Morrison. 

Developed For Television And Written By Russell Rainey. 

* THE KNIGHT WARRIOR : THE MASKED CRUSADER : The TV Series Pitch Deck Now In Development. 

* Pitch Deck Concept Art Preview.  

* Seeking Buyer To Executive Produce 6 Episode Live -  Action TV Series. 

* TV Series For Sale. 

* A Superhero Action Thriller Crime Television Series. 

* Comic Book Style TV Series Concept Art By Russell Rainey And Chy Tha Brat. 

INSPIRED BY : THE BATMAN (2022), ARROW (2012 - 2020), THE FLASH (2014 - 2023), POWER BOOK IV : FORCE (2022 - 2025), THE PENGUIN (2024), DAREDEVIL (2003), And L. A. TAKEDOWN (1989).

LA FABRIQUE DU SCÉNARIO : LES FONDAMENTAUX DE L’ÉCRITURE DRAMATIQUE
FORMATION INTENSIVE DE 15 JOURS | 120H | AFDAS | MARSEILLE 
Du 02 au 20 novembre 2026 (inclu)

Cette formation en trois semaines propose une immersion complète dans l’apprentissage des fondamentaux de l’écriture scénaristique. Elle articule théorie, pratique et analyse afin de permettre aux participant·e·s de comprendre, expérimenter et affiner les principes clés de la dramaturgie à travers le développement de scènes.
Pendant trois semaines, les stagiaires évoluent sous la houlette de trois scénaristes reconnu·e·s qui interviennent à tour de rôle, chacun·e dans sa spécialité.

IRÈNE CAMARGO DE STAAL
Scénariste
https://www.agence-ifonly.fr/talent/irene_camargo-de-staal.htm
Scénariste pour le cinéma et la télévision, Irène Camargo de Staal a débuté en tant que technicienne pour le cinéma (monteuse, scripte, assistante), après une solide formation initiale en Lettres et Philosophie. 

Après avoir vécu à Rio de Janeiro (sa ville natale), à Paris et à Rome, Irène s’installe à Marseille, sa ville de cœur. Elle y travaille plusieurs années notamment à la coordination d’écriture, sur une série quotidienne marseillaise, et collabore par la suite à l’écriture de longs-métrages de cinéma et bibles de séries. Elle affûte peu à peu ses outils en suivant de nombreux workshops et résidences (ARTE/Groupe Ouest, Emergence, CEEA, Ciné-Comédies…). 

Parallèlement à son activité de scénariste, Irène encadre des formations et ateliers d’écriture pour le GROUPE OUEST, la CinéFabrique, le CEFPF, Mille Sabords et la Cité européenne des Scénaristes. 

Elle a également travaillé en tant que consultante pour AMAZON Studios (séries et unitaires fiction). Après avoir collaboré à l’écriture de la saison 2 de la série Escort Boys de Ruben Alvès (diffusion AMAZON Prime), Irène développe actuellement divers projets de longs-métrages et de séries, principalement en comédie — dont Clairebnb (26′) produite par AGAT FILMS, Fantômas le retour (8x52’) pour Canal +, et une autre pour HBO.

NICOLAS FLEUREAU
Scénariste
https://www.vma.fr/fiche.cfm/739006_nicolas-fleureau
Passionné de cinéma depuis l'âge de 12 ans « à cause » d'un visionnage d'Alien de Ridley Scott qui lui causa quelques nuits blanches, Nicolas Fleureau se lance dans des études audiovisuelles qui le mène du lycée Louis Feuillade de Lunel à la faculté Paris 3. Il enchaîne quelques années comme électro puis se forme au scénario. 

Entre 2009 et 2023 il coécrit ou collabore à l'écriture de plusieurs courts et longs-métrages de fiction dont Corporate de Nicolas Silhol et Chien de la Casse de Jean Baptiste Durand, primé du César du meilleur premier film et nominé pour le César du meilleur scénario. 

En parallèle, il accompagne la création de l'école Kourtrajmé fondée par Ladj Li dans laquelle il enseigne l'art du récit cinématographique depuis 2018. 

Actuellement, Nicolas Fleureau coécrit le deuxième long-métrage de Nicolas Birkenstock "L'Allemand sans peine" pour TS production, coréalise une série documentaire sur Street Fighter pour Folamour Production et co écrit un film intitulé Le Fan et produit par Lyly Film c'est à dire Ladj Ly.

GUILLAUME GROSSE
Scénariste
https://www.imdb.com/fr/name/nm3777220/
Après des études de cinéma à l’Université d’Aix en Provence et au Canada, à l’Université de Montréal ; Guillaume Grosse se spécialise comme scénariste à la Fémis puis au Conservatoire Européen d’Écriture Audiovisuelle. En tant qu’auteur ou co-auteur, ses courts métrages sont plusieurs fois primés, obtenant notamment le grand prix du Festival Premiers Plans et le prix du jury Unifrance à Cannes. 

Son premier long métrage de fiction ( Toril, sortie salle en 2017 ) et son premier long métrage documentaire ( Low Tech, sortie salle en 2023 ), remportent également plusieurs prix et sont diffusés à l’international. 
En fiction audiovisuelle, il a participé à l’écriture d’une mini-série policière ainsi que d’une collection de quotidiennes pour France Télévision. 

Il est également co-créateur de la série Malditos, diffusée sur HBO depuis juin 2025. En parallèle de ses activités de scénariste, Guillaume Grosse enseigne la dramaturgie en l'universités, en écoles de cinéma, et dirige des ateliers d’écriture.

LOÏC NICOLOFF
Scénariste & réalisateur
https://www.loicnicoloff.com
Actualité : Son long métrage LE GARDIEN DES ÉTOILES, produit par les Films d’Avalon, est en cours de financement. Loïc Nicoloff développe très tôt une passion pour le récit et le cinéma, marquée par la découverte de L’Empire contre-attaque dans son enfance. Après avoir exercé divers métiers sur des tournages, il se spécialise dans l’écriture de scénarios pour le cinéma et la télévision, notamment sur les séries Vestiaires et Immeuble Partagé. 

Réalisateur d’une vingtaine de courts métrages, il signe notamment Rocambolesque, une comédie historique primée en France et à l’international, qui plonge dans l’univers des feuilletonistes du XIXe siècle. 

En collaborant avec Arleston sur la série Léo Loden, il ajoute le scénario de Bande Dessinée à sa palette. Il écrit des albums aux univers variés, dans des histoires complètes (Les Belles Vertes, Dômes, Kaeloo) ou des gags en une planche (Nos Chers Voisins, Kaeloo). Passionné de littérature, il publie en 2024 un recueil de nouvelles intitulé Au seuil de contes oubliées, et participe aux ouvrages collectifs Le Cercle des polardeux marseillais (saison 3, 2025, et saison finale, 2026). Il travaille actuellement sur un premier roman. 

Attentif aux évolutions technologiques et à leur impact sur la narration, il intègre régulièrement de nouveaux outils numériques dans son processus créatif. Il explore notamment les applications de l’intelligence artificielle comme support pour les auteurs, tout en préservant l’authenticité et la singularité de leur voix. Installé près d’Aix-en-Provence, il intervient régulièrement en tant que lecteur, consultant pour des producteurs, des festivals et des institutions, et enseigne l’écriture de scénario à l’université d’Aix-Marseille, à l’université de Cannes, ainsi qu’aux Ateliers d’Image et de Son (AIS) de Marseille.

LES INSCRIPTIONS SONT OUVERTES

Professionnel.le.s du cinéma et/ou de l’audiovisuel, artistes, écrivain.e.s, débutant.e.s ou confirmé.e.s merci de nous envoyer votre dossier de candidature
- CV
- Photos
- Lettre de motivation 

à info@clapclass.fr ou sur notre site www.clapclass.fr

Financement AFDAS > Date limite de dépôt des dossiers le 02 octobre 2026

Financement France Travail > Date limite de dépôt des dossiers le 09 octobre 2026

Financement personnel > Possible dans la limite des places disponibles (nous contacter)

Hello everyone, I'm looking for a **VFX artist** and an** intern **to join the post production team on our feature film. The work is very minimal and light.

We've just wrapped shooting on a feature that's best described as **Black Mirror** meets **Everything Everywhere All at Once**, with stylistic elements similar to **The Backrooms**. A few behind the scenes photos are attached below.

Our post production team is currently being led by someone from Marvel and we're editing in **DaVinci Resolve**.

We're currently looking for:

**- 1 x VFX Artist**

**- 1 x VFX Intern**

*The internship position is unpaid, but the workload is light and flexible. You'll have the opportunity to work directly alongside our  Marvel VFX artist, and all roles will receive an on screen credit.*

If this sounds like something you'd be interested in, please send me a DM or email **admin@infinitystudios.com.au** with your website or portfolio or samples of your work, along with the title of the position you're applying for.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Film & TV Teacher - PQA Haywards Heath
Are you ready to inspire the next generation of filmmakers? Are you a filmmaker or have industry knowledge of film and television production? Then PQA Haywards Heath want to hear from you!

PQA, a leading provider of weekend performing arts training, is currently looking for a local filmmaker to work with our students at Warden Park Secondary Academy, (RH17 5DP) on a Saturday morning and afternoon (Starting at £60 per session), devising and shooting short films with students.

You will be leading filmmaking workshops with children from 6 – 18 years creating material that can ultimately be screened in a local cinema and shared online. You will ideally have some experience working with children and young people and have a strong background making short films or television.

PQA follows safer recruiting. An enhanced DBS on the update service will be required and can be arranged.

For more information or to apply please email Florence.tingley@pqacademy.com with a CV and covering letter.

🎥 Montaż demo aktorskiego z konsultacją 

Potrzebujesz demo aktorskiego, które pokaże Twój talent aktorski i wszechstronność a jednocześnie będzie zgodne z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu? Chcesz dowiedzieć się jak pobierać materiały i jak tworzyć takie demo samemu w przyszłości w łatwy sposób oraz jak zwiększyć swoje szanse na konkretną role? Jeżeli tak to zapraszam do skorzystania z mojej usługi 🙂 

✅ dokładnie przejrzę Twoje aktorskie materiały, wybiorę najlepsze aktorsko sceny oraz różnorodne pod względem emocji i ról

✅ zmontuję demo zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu uwzględniając również to, które sceny Ty uważasz za najlepsze 

✅ podczas konsultacji opowiem Ci o obecnych standardach montażu i doboru scen, dam dużo cennych rad abyś mogła / mógł w przyszłości montować demo samodzielnie 

✅ gotowe demo dostaniesz ode mnie maksymalnie w 2 dni od wysłania mi swoich materiałów

✅ przystępna cena 💵 szczegóły na priv 

Na zdjęciach załączam jedną z wiadomość od klienta po moim montażu 🔥💪 

Uwaga! Nie zajmuję się pobieraniem materiałów.

CASTING CALL: MÄNNLICHE HAUPTROLLE – MUSICAL (VERGÜTET)
Für die kontinentaleuropäische Erstaufführung des Zwei-Personen-Musicals  “THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK” suchen wir einen männlichen Darsteller/Sänger für eine zentrale Rolle. 

ÜBER DAS STÜCK:

New York 1950. Ein Broadway-Komponist, dessen Name heute vollkommen in Vergessenheit geraten ist. Seine Songs, seine Geschichten und alte Theater-Mythen führen zwei Menschen auf die Suche nach der Wahrheit einer vergessenen Broadway Legende. 

DIE ROLLE:

Die männliche Hauptrolle in “THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK” ist ein charismatischer, humorvoller und aufgeschlossener Schauspieler, der von der mysteriösen Geschichte rund um Wilbur Weissman fasziniert ist. Im Laufe des Stücks schlüpft er in mehrere verschiedene Rollen und verkörpert damit die unterschiedlichen Figuren innerhalb des „Stücks im Stück“. Die Rolle erfordert daher eine hohe schauspielerische Wandlungsfähigkeit, Spielfreude und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Charaktere präzise und glaubwürdig zum Leben zu erwecken. Die Rolle trägt den Namen des Darstellers.

Spielalter: 25 – 40 Jahre

Stimmfach: Bariton/hoher Bariton (g² – f⁴)

Geschlecht: male presenting

Spiel- & Probenort: Wien (Leider kann keine Unterkunft gestellt werden.)

WIR SUCHEN: 

– hervorragender Schauspieler und Sänger

– sehr starke Bühnenpräsenz

– gutes Timing und komödiantisches Gespür

– Tanzkenntnisse erforderlich (Jazz/Musical)

– sehr gutes Englisch (c1 - c2)

– Interesse an Jazz und Musical

Professionelle Ausbildung und/oder einschlägige Bühnenerfahrung ist vorausgesetzt. Erfahrung im Jazz- & Musical Bereich sind stark von Vorteil.

PRODUKTION: 

THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK – von Emerson Hurley und Dylan McBurney

Regie: Simon Malleczek

Musikalische Leitung: Emerson Hurley

Premiere: April 2027, Freie Bühne Wien

Produktion: Theater zwischen Welten

Sprache: Dialog in Deutscher- & Songs in Englischer Sprache.

BEWERBUNG: 

Bitte schicke uns: 

– Kurzbiographie

– Künstlerische Vita

– Portraitfoto

– Hörprobe/Video (keine Voraussetzung)

 Bewerbungen bitte mit dem Betreff “Bewerbung TFS – [Dein Name]” an “office@zwischen-welten.theater” bis zum 20.09.26 einreichen. Es werden nur vollständige Bewerbungen berücksichtigt. Im Falle einer Einladung zum Casting schicken wir dir weitere Informationen und Voraussetzungen. 

Bei Fragen: PN

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

CASTING CALL - A Last Crusade, an Independent short film - NON-UNION

Read-through date: Friday, Sept 4th, 2026
Shoot date: Saturday, Sept 5th, 2026

Location: North Delta, BC

Compensation: $350 flat (7 max hour shoot (hoping for 5 hours) + 1 hour read-through)

We are casting a 35+ male with a larger build to play the lead (Barron). This role will involve donning corpse-like make-up.

Synopsis: One part heartwarming family drama and one part existential horror; A Last Crusade follows Bret, as his recently deceased father reappears to him in a dream with the simple request of binge-watching the original Indiana Jones trilogy with him, one final time.

Role Description:

Barron (35+): A large, imposing figure who embodies both the nurturing kindness and the repressed anger of a troubled father. In his current state, his body has begun to disfigure from time spent in the grave.

If you are interested, please submit your headshots, CV, and a reel (if available) to aleksanderoclarino@gmail.com using the subject line: A Last Crusade Barron Audition. We will reply with a copy of the script if we are interested.

We are very excited to see your submissions.

🎭 AUDITIONS TONY N’ TINA’S WEDDING! 🇮🇹💍

Vancouver’s smash-hit interactive dinner theatre Tony n’ Tina’s Wedding is looking to add a few new faces to the famiglia!

We’re currently accepting submissions and holding auditions now through mid-September for upcoming performances.

🎭 CURRENTLY SEEKING: • Female performers, ages 19–35
• Male performers, ages 19–35
• Strong acting and improv skills are a big asset
• Singers  definitely let us know! 🎤
• Comfortable with basic choreography? Let us know! 💃🕺

This is a non-equity production.
 UBCP/ACTRA performers are welcome to submit.

💰 Performances are paid an honorarium. Rehearsals are unpaid.

📅 SHOW & REHEARSAL COMMITMENT

Our performances are generally scheduled one Friday and Saturday per month.

Rehearsals are typically held on Sundays from approximately 12:30–4:00 PM, with our main rehearsal usually taking place the Sunday prior to each show weekend. Additional rehearsals may occasionally be scheduled when bringing several new performers into the cast.

In most months, performers can expect one Sunday rehearsal leading into the Friday/Saturday performances.

🎟️ UPCOMING SHOW DATES:

 October 16 & 17
November 20 & 21
December 4 & 5

Tony n’ Tina’s Wedding is an immersive, interactive comedy where the actors mingle and improv with the audience throughout an unforgettable Italian wedding reception. We’re looking for energetic performers who love character work, comedy and thinking on their feet!

🎬 Produced & Directed by Jeff Laurin
Assistant Director / Stage Manager: Chellé Tanner
Associate Producer: Gavin Marck

Interested in joining the famiglia?

Email us at  hammerupproductions@gmail.com
Instagram @TNTWeddingShow

Send us a little about yourself, your acting experience, a headshot/resumé, and your general availability so we can arrange an audition time and date.

🇮🇹 Come join the wedding  once you’re famiglia, you’re famiglia! ❤️🍝💍

🎬 HAS YOUR CHILD GOT IT?
It's a question I've heard hundreds of times from parents.
“Matt… do you think they could actually be an actor?”
And there's a problem.
I can't answer that by looking at a photograph.
You probably can't answer it from watching them perform around the house.
And sometimes even THEY don't know yet.
You have to give them the opportunity to find out.
Because acting potential comes in all sorts of packages.
🎭 The child who LOVES performing.
🎥 The one obsessed with films and television.
😂 The entertainer who has the whole family laughing.
🧠 The incredibly imaginative one.
👀 The quiet observer who notices EVERYTHING.
Sometimes the child you least expect comes alive when a camera is switched on.
That's why we created MZA JUNIORS.
Professional ONLINE screen acting training designed specifically for young performers.
Not simply “drama games”.
SCREEN ACTING. 🎬
Young actors learn to:
🎭 Create believable characters
🎥 Perform naturally on camera
🧠 Break down scripts
👀 Actually listen and react
🔥 Make brave acting choices
💪 Develop confidence
🎬 Understand professional screen acting technique
And being online actually gives them a HUGE advantage for screen acting.
Every week, the camera is right there.
They become comfortable performing into it.
They learn how they appear on screen.
And they develop skills that translate directly into the world of self-tapes, Zoom auditions and modern casting.
Do they need experience?
NO.
Do they need an agent?
NO.
Do they need to already be brilliant?
Definitely not! 😂
They just need to have an interest in acting and be willing to have a go.
And we're going to make that first step incredibly easy.
🎁 THEIR FIRST CLASS IS FREE.
Maybe acting becomes something they pursue professionally.
Maybe it simply gives them more confidence.
Maybe they make friends and discover something they love.
Or maybe...
You watch that first class and think:
“Wow. I didn't know they could do THAT.”
There's only one way to find out.
🎬 HAS YOUR CHILD GOT IT?
DON'T WONDER.
LET THEM FIND OUT.
🎁 TRY THEIR FIRST CLASS FREE
👉 mzacting.com

items.text:
Six men have played James Bond. Thousands have auditioned for the role. And after going through decades of screen-test footage, I've found something that surprised me: the audition has almost nothing to do with talent.

George Lazenby got the part in 1968 having never acted professionally in his life — he lied his way into the room and behaved like Bond until the producers believed him. Henry Cavill's screen test was reportedly brilliant, and he still lost the role for a reason he had zero control over. Even the test scene itself is a trap: since Sean Connery, every actor auditioning for Bond has had to perform a scene the previous Bond already played on screen.

I've spent years on both sides of the casting table — as an actor (EastEnders) and as a producer casting other people's projects — and this is the most extreme version of a pattern I see in every audition room, for every part, at every level.

In this week's video I break down the five things a Bond screen test is actually measuring, using the actual footage: Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan, Henry Cavill, Sam Heughan, and the story of how Daniel Craig won Barbara Broccoli over before he even read a line.

Whether you're auditioning for a soap, a franchise, or a fringe theatre production this month, these five lessons apply.

The link as usual is in the comments 👇

#ActingTips #JamesBond #AuditionAdvice

Merci d'envoyer votre candidature 2 photos + CV + Bande Démo + **présentation de max 2 min où vous parlez ce que représente pour vous l'engagement en politique** à [talents@desert-prod.com](mailto:hello@desert-prod.com)

Seules les candidatures correspondantes seront étudiées. 

Merci et belle journée !

🎬 CASTING CALL — MULATRESSE

We are casting for an international production.

👤 Looking for:

- African male
- Age: 40–70 years old
- Must speak well-spoken English
- Professional and available for international travel

💰 Fee: €2,000 (approximately R38,000, depending on the exchange rate on the day)

📅 Availability: From 5 September 2026
The commitment is approximately 4 days, including travel, wardrobe/fitting, shoot and return travel.

✈️ VERY IMPORTANT:
Candidates MUST have a valid passport and a valid European/International visa that allows them to travel for the production.

📩 To suggest a talent, please send:

- Full name
- Age
- Passport nationality
- Type/status of European/International visa
- Passport validity/expiry date
- Confirmation of availability from 5 September
- Contact number
- Recent headshot

Please only suggest talent who meet ALL the requirements above.

Self-tapes will be requested from shortlisted suggestions.

📞 WhatsApp: 0796802659

# 🎬 STATISTER SØGES TIL KORTFILM I AARHUS 🎬

Vi er lige nu i fuld gang med kortfilmen *ELTAL*, en **cassette sci-fi**. Hertil mangler vi nogle statister.

**VI SØGER STATISTER**
* Alder: Fra 18 år og op
* Køn er underordnet

**LIDT OM PROJEKTET**

*ELTAL* foregår i en verden, hvor tid er blevet den nye valuta. Da Erland uretfærdigt bliver fyret fra sit arbejde, står han tilbage med kun få timers strøm, før hans liv er slut. I et desperat forsøg på at overleve må han finde alternative måder at skaffe strøm på.

**DET PRAKTISKE**
* **Optagelser:** Lørdag d. 12. september
* **Lokation:** Aarhus
* Projektet er ulønnet, men vi sørger selvfølgelig for god forplejning på set.

**KONTAKT**

Hvis du har lyst til at være med eller kender nogen, der kunne være et godt match, så send mig en besked og et billede af dig selv her på Facebook eller på mail: [marie.korsgaard.rasmussen@gmail.com](mailto:marie.korsgaard.rasmussen@gmail.com). 🎥

🎬 CASTING CALL — CANDY KANE 🎬
We’re looking for passionate actors to join an ambitious independent British horror feature.

CANDY KANE is a British road horror / psychological slasher set across England and Wales in 2015, with filming planned around Bristol, Gloucester and South Wales in January/February 2027.

This is a non-budget independent production, meaning cast and crew roles are currently unpaid. We want to be completely transparent about that — but we also want to create something that people can genuinely be proud to be part of.

❤️ WHY THIS FILM MATTERS TO US

This film is more than just a horror project.

My co-director has cerebral palsy and is disabled, and Candy Kane is a dream he has been working towards — to make a feature film and prove that disability should never be seen as a barrier to pursuing ambitious creative goals.

As his co-director, I want to help him make that dream a reality.

We want to bring together a passionate group of filmmakers, actors and creatives who believe that great stories can be made through determination, collaboration and people believing in each other.

We don’t have a huge budget or a major studio behind us. What we do have is a story we believe in, a clear vision, and the determination to make the best film we possibly can.

We want Candy Kane to feel genuinely British — real roads, service stations, industrial estates, rural locations and everyday environments — with the horror growing naturally from a world audiences recognise.

If you’re an actor who loves horror, psychological thrillers, independent filmmaking and wants to be part of a team building something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

🎭 CASTING NOW OPEN

📍 Bristol / Gloucester / South Wales & surrounding areas

🎬 Feature-length independent horror

📅 January / February 2027 — exact dates TBC

💰 Non-budget / unpaid production

📩 To apply: Chardmedia43@gmail.com & lileev302@gmail.com

Please send your headshot, CV, showreel/previous work, age range, location and availability.

Come and help us turn a dream into a feature film.

items.text:
"Happy Little Accident" Casting Call for 
Shits n' Giggles short film.
“Happy Little Accident”

What if you could check a person out of a library the same way you check out a book and instead of reading their story, you could borrow their perspective, ask for advice or learn something from them? “Happy Little Accident” is a dark dramedy about addiction and recovery. But at its heart, it asks this question: What if helping someone take their first step forces you to confront your own sobriety?

DIESEL - a large bearded man, biker type, but very well spoken and intelligent, in his late 40's-50’s.

JESSICA - Female,mid 30’s presents all business but tired; professional dreamer, mom, trophy wife with the heart of a CEO, quick witted but a mess inside. 

RECEPTIONIST- Caring librarian type type, 50+

Shoot Date: September 6, 2026 - 8:00am

"The Recovered Arts Collective is producing as part of their Filmmakers Bootcamp. We are strongly supporting the creation of a cast with peoples with lived experience of addiction as this is the underlying theme of both films, but not a requirment. As well, we are seeking submissions from all communities including IBPOC and 2SLGBTQIA+."
Casting Call
1. Carefully read character profiles
2. Submit photo, resume and character(s) you wish to audition for at: https://forms.gle/TrkUhDMHCv4C6LVS8 or email hello@therecoveredartscollective.org
3. You will receive a script portion for self-tape.
4. Make self tape as per industry standards - BUT WOW! US! 
5. Upload self-tape to YouTube or Vimeo and email link to email:hello@therecoveredartscollective.org NO DOWNLOAD LINKS

Volunteer basis, IMDB credit, Video for Reel, Lunch provided.
#soberaf #recovery #recoveryispossible #recoveryjourney #mentalhealth

items.text:
Budujemy twórczą, czułą społeczność na Mokotowie!
Jesteśmy duetem twórczym. Działamy od wielu lat. Z zawodu Jesteśmy aktorami. Ale odeszliśmy z teatru. Postanowiliśmy zbudować własną przestrzeń. W poszanowaniu dla granic. Bez przemocy i presji. Tworzymy własny teatr - profesjonalne spektakle. Prowadzimy też warsztaty artystyczne. 

Zapraszamy Cię do naszej Akademii Sceny. Spotykamy się w gronie dorosłych i młodzieży. Uczymy profesjonalnego teatru. Tworzymy spektakle. Wymieniamy doświadczenia. Odpoczywamy. Działamy w poczuciu bezpieczeństwa i z dbałością o dobrostan emocjonalny. 

Dołącz do naszej drużyny Czułego Teatru! Spotykamy się w środy o 17.30 w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się o nas więcej, odwiedź stronę internetową Czuła Fundacja. Informacje o wszystkich naszych warsztatach artystycznych znajdziesz na stronie FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie.

Dołącz do nas! Budujmy razem czułą i twórczą przestrzeń na Mokotowie!

Chcesz zostać aktorką/aktorem albo mieć więcej aktorskiej pracy ale nie wiesz co konkretnie zrobić? 🤔 Jeżeli tak - zapraszam na konsultacje do mnie, nagranie wizytówek i montaż demo aktorskiego! 🎬🤩 Szczegóły w opisie! 

🎥 Mentoring aktorski 

Dla kogo? 

Dla każdego kto chce pracować jako aktor/aktorka na planach zdjęciowych. Zarówno dla tych bez doświadczenia, któryórzy nie wiedzą jak zacząć i co zrobić jak i dla tych co już pierwsze kroki mają za sobą ale chcieliby mieć więcej pracy i potrzebują rady w tym zakresie 🙂 

Na czym polega? 

Spotkanie ze mną 1:1 online, trwające godzinę. Opowiesz mi jakie zlecenia aktorskie Cię interesują - czyli Twój aktorski cel i według tego dobieramy odpowiedni plan działania. Jeżeli masz materiały aktorskie - to je omówimy i powiem co warto byłoby jeszcze do nich dodać lub jak je “podrasować”. Jeżeli nie masz to dowiesz się co i jak masz zrobić żeby je mieć 🙂 Powiem o moich poleceniach agencji aktorskich, jak samodzielnie i łatwo zrobić demo, jak nagrać i co powiedzieć w wizytówkach, jak samodzielnie szukać pracy, jak się wyceniać, na co uważać. I odpowiem na wszystkie inne Twoje pytania. Po spotkaniu otrzymasz ode mnie maila z planem działania i priorytetami do wykonania + materiałami pomocniczymi dot. materiałów aktorskich. 

🎥 Coaching aktorski z wizytówki + nagranie wizytówek w studio 

Na czym polega? 

✅ Tworzę tekst do wizytówek na podstawie informacji o Twoim doświadczeniu, pasjach, zainteresowaniach, który dostajesz przed nagraniem według castingowych wytycznych, który pokaże Twoje największe atuty

✅W studio nagrań nagrywamy 3-4 wizytówki:

🎬 do filmów i seriali 
🎬 do reklam w wersji dłuższej 
🎬 do reklam w wersji krótszej 
🎬 w języku obcym 
Ewentualnie możemy dograć wizytówkę modelingową 

✅ W trakcie nagrywania zadbam o Twoje rozluźnienie, dobrą atmosferę oraz zrobimy kilka ćwiczeń które pomogą pokazać na wizytówkach Twoją energię i błysk w oku 
oraz będę czuwać nad całym procesem

✅ Wizytówki nagramy według aktualnych standardów i wymogów castingowych 

✅ Dostaniesz zmontowane wizytówki gotowe do wysłania przez WeTransfer

🎥 Demo aktorskie 

montaż demo aktorskiego + konsultacja 

Na czym polega? 

✅ otrzymasz ode mnie demo aktorskie zmontowane zgodnie z obecnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu + podczas konsultacji wspólnie dobierzemy sceny, które się w nim znajdą oraz przedstawię Ci mój pomysł na ich kolejność 

Podczas konsultacji dowiesz się również:

✅ jak pobierać materiały do demo aktorskiego 
✅ jakie są obecne wymogi i standardy wzgledem aktorskiego demo 
✅ jakie sceny wybierać i w jakiej kolejności je zmontować  
✅ jak samemu w łatwy sposób przemontować demo pod konkretny casting 

Szczegóły priv

Witam!

Do udziału w kampanii społecznej na temat szkodliwości spożywania alkoholu w ciąży poszukujemy:
1. GŁÓWNEJ BOHATERKI - kobiety w wieku 25–30 lat, dla której język polski jest językiem ojczystym
2. PARTNERA - mężczyzny w wieku 28–35 lat, dla którego język polski jest językiem ojczystym
3. CIOCI - kobiety w wieku 45–50 lat, dla której język polski jest językiem ojczystym
4. WUJKA - mężczyzny w wieku 50–55 lat, dla którego język polski jest językiem ojczystym
5. STATYSTÓW - dwóch osób, płeć dowolna

Szczegóły projektu:
1. Lokalizacja: prywatny dom pod Warszawą, około 25 km od Mokotowa
2. Dzień zdjęciowy: 2 września, jeden dzień na planie
3. Pola eksploatacji: internet, media społecznościowe oraz prezentacje podczas konferencji. 
4. Dialogi: krótkie kwestie – około 3–4 zdań, być może tylko jedno zdanie
5. Zapewniamy wynagrodzenie za udział w kampanii.

Zgłoszenia (wizytówkę, nagranie itp.) prosimy przesyłać mailowo na adres: sync@mi82.eu

**W tytule wiadomości prosimy zaznaczyć, na którą rolę Państwo aplikują.**

Dziękuję bardzo i pozdrawiam.

items.text:
**CASTING CALL**

Title: Romulus 

Genre: Drama

Logline: A volatile, emotionally guarded teenage boy attempting to find his dysfunctional mother on the Fourth of July, after being abandoned with his stern grandmother.

Hello! My name is Rayonna Price and I am producing a University of Colorado Denver Senior Thesis Film. Written and Directed by Saroja Manickam, Romulus is a coming-of-age film that explores the themes of generational trauma and grief.

We are currently casting for ALL ROLES! Lead role and supporting will be COMPENSATED!

**Cody** (13-15, Male, LEADING): An emotionally guarded teenager grieving his mother’s abandonment. *Must be comfortable with profanity and mature themes.*

**Maggie** (20's-30's, Female, Supporting): Cody’s mother, a dysfunctional woman who loves fiercely but without stability. She struggles with her mental health and substance abuse, complicating her ability to parent.

**June** (60's, Female, Supporting): Cody’s grandmother, a blunt, no-nonsense woman guarding her guilt. Her love isn't always tender but it's constant.

**Young Mother** (20's-30's, Female, Extra): A mom Cody mistakens for his own

**Young Cody/Child** (5-10, Male, Extra): A younger Cody and the son of the mother Cody mistakens as Maggie.

To audition both In-Person and through Self-Tape, please scan the QR code or fill out the form linked: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfSbxLLuja8spbcybSSjtnSnSAZlJHrWNCGcq0gwf_fY0g0kg/viewform?usp=header](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfSbxLLuja8spbcybSSjtnSnSAZlJHrWNCGcq0gwf_fY0g0kg/viewform?usp=header)

Here is the link to our Backstage as well: [https://www.backstage.com/casting/romulus-3222070/](https://www.backstage.com/casting/romulus-3222070/)

All In-Person Auditions will take place on September 5th-6th from 11 a.m.-3 p.m. at Denver Public Library: Rodolfo "Corky" Gonzales Branch Library on the second floor conference room. 

If you have any questions, please email me at pricer625@gmail.com

Thank you!

SG Casting is casting The Lone Tree Arts Center’s production of Amadeus in Lone Tree, Colorado!

Both local and non-local talent are encouraged to submit an audition!

AEA audition sign ups will open on Monday, August 17th.

Non-AEA audition sign ups will open on Wednesday, August 26th.

If you are local, please sign up for an in-person audition if possible.  

If you are not local, please plan to submit a video audition. 

The Lone Tree Arts Center’s Executive Director is Leigh Chandler.

$950.00 minimum for Principals and Understudies/Swings

Director: Geoffrey Kent

Executive Director: Leigh Chandler

Casting Director: Sylvia Gregory, CSA

All above creative team members will be present at auditions and viewing audition videos.

In Person Initial Auditions: Monday September 14th and Tuesday September 15th.

In Person Callbacks: Monday October 5th; will add Tuesday October 6th if needed.

Video general auditions are due by Friday September 11th..

Video callbacks are due by Friday, October 2nd.

Tech Starts - 3/31/27

Invited Rehearsals - 4/7/27

Opening - 4/8/27

Closing - 4/18/27

General Audition Requirements:

Please prepare one monologue or two contrasting monologues not to exceed 3 minutes total.

For in-person and video auditions:

In person auditions are by appointment only. Sign up, upload headshots and resumes, and/or submit your videos all at this link: 

https://www.lonetreeartscenter.org/amadeusauditions

Headshot and Resume are REQUIRED to be uploaded into Production Tools.

Do not contact members of the production teams. If you have any questions, contact Saundra Bergman at Saundra.Bergman@cityoflonetree.com.

The Lone Tree Arts Center is committed to diversity and maintains a policy of equal employment opportunity designed to promote a positive model of inclusion. As such, we encourage performers of all ethnicities, gender identities, body types and sizes, and ages, as well as performers with disabilities, to audition for appropriate roles.

The Lone Tree Arts Center creates a safe and equitable workplace through policies defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, the Actors’ Equity Association, and the City of Lone Tree. These policies provide a comprehensive framework for health and safety of all actors, stage managers, creative staff, and designers employed by The Lone Tree Arts Center.

Information and Character Breakdown

CASTING NOTE:

Antonio Salieri and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart will be cast with male-presenting performers. Constanze Weber will be cast with a female-identifying performer, as the character is pregnant at one point in the play. 

All other roles are open to performers of any gender. Performers of all genders and gender expressions are encouraged to audition. 

Character genders, pronouns, relationships, and historical identities will remain as written in the script; performers will not be asked to portray a gender different from their own.

Roles:

ANTONIO SALIERI, male-presenting, 50 to 65

Court Composer to the Emperor. Brilliant, ambitious, and deeply conflicted, he serves as narrator while recounting his lifelong rivalry with Mozart. Exceptional command of language and emotional range required.

WOLFGANG AMADEUS MOZART, male-presenting, 25 to 35

A musical genius with boundless wit, irreverence, and youthful energy. Mercurial, funny, and deeply vulnerable beneath his exuberance.

CONSTANZE WEBER MOZART, female-presenting, 20 to 35 

Mozart’s devoted wife. Intelligent, resilient, and fiercely practical as she struggles to support her husband and family. Role will also include Ensemble work.

EMPEROR JOSEPH II, 35 to 55 

Emperor of Austria. Affable, curious, and genuinely devoted to music, though often unaware of his own limitations. Strong comic instincts. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON VAN SWIETEN, 50 to 70 

Influential patron of the arts. Intellectual, dignified, and quietly authoritative. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT VON STRACK, 35 to 60 

Court official. Polished, ambitious, and committed to preserving decorum and tradition. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT ORSINI-ROSENBERG, 40 to 65 

Imperial Director of Opera. Conservative, politically savvy, and skeptical of artistic risk. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON WALSEGG, 40 to 65 

Wealthy aristocrat with a mysterious presence. Reserved and imposing. Role will also include Ensemble work.

Two VENTICELLI, 30 to 50 

The “Little Winds.” Nimble storytellers who provide gossip, exposition, and comic energy. Excellent timing and verbal dexterity required.

KATHERINA CAVALIERI, 20 to 40 

Celebrated soprano and former student of Salieri. Confident, poised, and accustomed to admiration. Classical singing ability welcome but not required. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

TERESA SALIERI, 40 to 60 

Salieri’s wife. Quiet, observant presence. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

ENSEMBLE

18+ To portray courtiers, servants, musicians, clergy, and opera performers. Strong ensemble skills and comfort with multiple roles. Singing and movement abilities a plus.

Hallo ihr Lieben! 😎

Heute in genau 3 Wochen, am 18.09.2026, ist es soweit: Wir veröffentlichen unsere Doku / unseren Kurzfilm „IN MY BLOOD – Ein Tag mit BEYOND OBSESSION“! 🎬🖤

Die TM Studio Film Crew hat uns einen ganzen Tag lang auf einem kleinen Festival begleitet – vor und hinter der Bühne.

Euch erwarten:
🎤 Live-Mitschnitte
🎙️ Interviews
🎬 Behind the Scenes
🖤 und ganz persönliche Einblicke in einen Tag mit BEYOND OBSESSION.

Für uns war es ein großartiges Erlebnis, diesen besonderen Tag gemeinsam mit dieser tollen Crew zu verbringen und nicht nur vor der Kamera zu stehen, sondern auch die Kameraarbeit und die Entstehung des Films hautnah mitzuerleben. ☺️🎬

Wir freuen uns riesig darauf, euch diesen Film zu zeigen und euch ein Stück weit mitzunehmen in unsere Welt. ❤️

📅 18.09.2026
🎬 IN MY BLOOD – Ein Tag mit BEYOND OBSESSION

Wir wünschen euch ein schönes Wochenende.

Stay tuned! 😎
Nils & Marco🖤

MÄNNLICHE HAUPTROLLE – MUSICAL (VERGÜTET)
Für die kontinentaleuropäische Erstaufführung des Zwei-Personen-Musicals  “THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK” suchen wir einen männlichen Darsteller/Sänger für eine zentrale Rolle. 

ÜBER DAS STÜCK:

New York 1950. Ein Broadway-Komponist, dessen Name heute vollkommen in Vergessenheit geraten ist. Seine Songs, seine Geschichten und alte Theater-Mythen führen zwei Menschen auf die Suche nach der Wahrheit einer vergessenen Broadway Legende. 

DIE ROLLE:

Die männliche Hauptrolle in “THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK” ist ein charismatischer, humorvoller und aufgeschlossener Schauspieler, der von der mysteriösen Geschichte rund um Wilbur Weissman fasziniert ist. Im Laufe des Stücks schlüpft er in mehrere verschiedene Rollen und verkörpert damit die unterschiedlichen Figuren innerhalb des „Stücks im Stück“. Die Rolle erfordert daher eine hohe schauspielerische Wandlungsfähigkeit, Spielfreude und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Charaktere präzise und glaubwürdig zum Leben zu erwecken. Die Rolle trägt den Namen des Darstellers.

Spielalter: 25 – 40 Jahre

Stimmfach: Bariton/hoher Bariton (g² – f⁴)

Geschlecht: male presenting

Spiel- & Probenort: Wien (Leider kann keine Unterkunft gestellt werden.)

WIR SUCHEN: 

– hervorragender Schauspieler und Sänger

– sehr starke Bühnenpräsenz

– gutes Timing und komödiantisches Gespür

– Tanzkenntnisse erforderlich (Jazz/Musical)

– sehr gutes Englisch (c1 - c2)

– Interesse an Jazz und Musical

Professionelle Ausbildung und/oder einschlägige Bühnenerfahrung ist vorausgesetzt. Erfahrung im Jazz- & Musical Bereich sind stark von Vorteil.

PRODUKTION: 

THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK – von Emerson Hurley und Dylan McBurney

Regie: Simon Malleczek

Musikalische Leitung: Emerson Hurley

Premiere: April 2027, Freie Bühne Wien

Produktion: Theater zwischen Welten

Sprache: Dialog in Deutscher- & Songs in Englischer Sprache.

BEWERBUNG: 

Bitte schicke uns: 

– Kurzbiographie

– Künstlerische Vita

– Portraitfoto

– Hörprobe/Video (keine Voraussetzung)

 Bewerbungen bitte mit dem Betreff “Bewerbung TFS – [Dein Name]” an “office@zwischen-welten.theater” bis zum 20.09.26 einreichen. Es werden nur vollständige Bewerbungen berücksichtigt. Im Falle einer Einladung zum Casting schicken wir dir weitere Informationen und Voraussetzungen. 

Bei Fragen: PN

Hey! I am working on 2 shows that is looking for people who are passionate about all things nerd culture. There is compensation and films in Los Angeles. It’s like Jubilee but discussing Sci-fi, Comics, anime, TTRPGs, DnD, GTA, Video Games, Manga, etc.
One show you rank your favs and talk it out with some of the creators. 
The second has you debate a celebrity on your fav shows, games, comics, anime etc. Let me know if you have any questions and if you know someone who would be great for either of these shows, please share the flyers.

🎬 CASTING | GŁÓWNA ROLA
Do niezależnego (non-profit) krótkometrażowego filmu fabularnego poszukujemy rosyjsko/ ukraińskojęzycznego aktora do głównej roli — młodego mężczyzny w wieku 18–25 lat.

Szukamy atrakcyjnej, zadbanej osoby z dobrą mimiką i charyzmą.

Ważna jest umiejętność łączenia pewności siebie w wyglądzie z nieśmiałością, niezręcznością i wyczuciem komediowym.

Looking for recent experiences with Lavonne’s The Agency in LA/Burbank. Has anyone’s child been represented by them recently? Did your child get auditions/bookings, and how was your overall experience? Would you recommend them? Looking for honest firsthand experiences—positive or negative.

Thank you. Has anyone here actually had their child represented by Lavonne’s in the last 1–2 years? I’d especially love to hear firsthand experiences about submissions/auditions and communication.

topComments.text:
I wouldn’t call them a scam. I would just say they are not well respected and ethical. 
They sign anyone and everyone, try and poach kids, charge them for photos, sell workshops etc. 

They are licensed, bonded, on the casting platforms and do book kids occasionally. But they are kinda bottom of the barrel and don’t operate ethically. 
 
I would pass and look for someone a lot more reputable.

also, for the record... no agent can control how many auditions you get, and especially how many bookings you get. that is a poor measure of a successful agent. different ages, ethnicities, genders, hair colors, looks, etc, will come and go, be popular and not popular. not every package is the same either. all the agent can do is submit the tools you provide them. so scam "agent" aside, if you aren't getting auditions, the first thing any actor needs to do is look at the materials being provided to their agents. i, for one, know my video footage (not my sons, mine) is sorely lacking. so i'm sure auditions aren't coming in because of that and i need to find the time (and funds) to fix that. bookings? thats out of everyone's hands, but it's still on you (your child) to be trained and prepared when those auditions come so that talent and skill are not the thing holding you back.

AKADEMIA STYLU I KADRU | WALK + PORTRET
z Piotrem Koprowskim, TOP MODEL 13

📍 KRAKÓW | 27.09

Chcesz zacząć przygodę z modelingiem, ale nie wiesz, od czego zacząć i czego właściwie powinnaś się nauczyć?

A może już chodzisz na castingi, bierzesz udział w sesjach, próbujesz swoich sił, ale masz poczucie, że wciąż stoisz w miejscu?

Patrzysz, jak inne dziewczyny dostają kolejne zlecenia i współprace, a Ty po raz kolejny słyszysz „odezwiemy się”?
Na wybiegu brakuje Ci pewności i techniki?
A przed aparatem wracasz ciągle do tych samych póz i min?

To nie musi oznaczać, że brakuje Ci urody, figury czy odpowiednich warunków, bo dziś modeling szuka różnorodności i osobowości. Wiele elementów pracy modelki można po prostu wypracować - poprzez wiedzę, technikę i praktykę.

Dlatego stworzyliśmy warsztaty skoncentrowane na dwóch umiejętnościach, które mają kluczowe  znaczenie w pracy modelki:

✦ WALK z Piotrem Koprowskim, półfinalistą TOP MODEL 13
Nie tylko nauczysz się chodzić po wybiegu. Popracujesz nad postawą, sylwetką, rytmem, krokiem, pracą ciała i sposobem prezentacji, aby poruszać się pewniej i bardziej świadomie - także podczas castingów.

✦ POZOWANIE DO ZDJĘĆ PORTRETOWYCH
Nauczysz się świadomie pracować spojrzeniem, mimiką, ustawieniem twarzy i górnej części ciała, żeby nie być modelką jednej miny i pokazać przed obiektywem większy zakres swojej ekspresji.

✦ PROFESJONALNE PORTRETY DO PORTFOLIO
Na koniec otrzymasz dwa profesjonalne zdjęcia wykonane przez Monikę Sobotę, specjalizującą się w fotografii kobiecej - czyli materiał, który możesz wykorzystać w swoim portfolio.

To nie będzie kolejny wykład.
To praktyka tego, jak wyróżnić się w tłumie. Lepiej wykorzystać własne atuty, świadomie pracować ciałem i twarzą oraz pewniej prezentować się przed ludźmi i obiektywem.

📍 Kraków | ul. Lema 32
📅 27 września 2026
🕙 10:00–15:00
✦ kameralna grupa | liczba miejsc ograniczona

PROWADZĄ:
Walk – Piotr Koprowski, TOP MODEL 13
Foto – Monika Sobota
Styl – Barbara Drzazga

💌 Chcesz zacząć albo wreszcie wejść na wyższy poziom? Napisz do nas wiadomość prywatną lub zostaw komentarz.

🎬 CASTING CALL — CANDY KANE 🎬
We’re looking for passionate actors to join an ambitious independent British horror feature.

CANDY KANE is a British road horror / psychological slasher set across England and Wales in 2015, with filming planned around Bristol, Gloucester and South Wales in January/February 2027.

This is a non-budget independent production, meaning cast and crew roles are currently unpaid. We want to be completely transparent about that — but we also want to create something that people can genuinely be proud to be part of.

❤️ WHY THIS FILM MATTERS TO US

This film is more than just a horror project.

My co-director has cerebral palsy and is disabled, and Candy Kane is a dream he has been working towards — to make a feature film and prove that disability should never be seen as a barrier to pursuing ambitious creative goals.

As his co-director, I want to help him make that dream a reality.

We want to bring together a passionate group of filmmakers, actors and creatives who believe that great stories can be made through determination, collaboration and people believing in each other.

We don’t have a huge budget or a major studio behind us. What we do have is a story we believe in, a clear vision, and the determination to make the best film we possibly can.

We want Candy Kane to feel genuinely British — real roads, service stations, industrial estates, rural locations and everyday environments — with the horror growing naturally from a world audiences recognise.

If you’re an actor who loves horror, psychological thrillers, independent filmmaking and wants to be part of a team building something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

🎭 CASTING NOW OPEN

📍 Bristol / Gloucester / South Wales & surrounding areas

🎬 Feature-length independent horror

📅 January / February 2027 — exact dates TBC

💰 Non-budget / unpaid production

📩 To apply: 

Chardmedia43@gmail.com

lileev302@gmail.com

Please send your headshot, CV, showreel/previous work, age range, location and availability.

Come and help us turn a dream into a feature film.

#CandyKane #CastingCall #Casting #Hor

🚨*CASTING CALL*🚨

Für den Abschlussfilm „TOTENBUCH“ von Lennart Glossner an der Hochschule Darmstadt sind wir noch dringend auf der Suche nach Kleindarsteller*innen und Kompars*innen.

*Darum gehts:*
Als der aktivistische Künstler Ben den Nachlass seines verstorbenen kleinen Bruders Ric sichtet, zwingt ihn ein hinterbliebenes Tagebuch in die wahnhafte Auseinandersetzung mit einer rechtsextremen Lebensrealität. TOTENBUCH ist ein 20-minütiger, experimenteller Kurzfilm, der die Themen Brüderliebe und Verlust zwischen politischen Fronten verhandelt. 

*Rollen, die wir noch suchen:*

Kleindarsteller*innen (mit Text)

- Schüler*innen (18 - 23 Jahre)

- ⁠Schuldirektorin (über 35 Jahre)

- Besitzer eines Imbissladens (über 30 Jahre, migrantisch gelesen)

Kompars*innen

- ⁠Altfaschist/ Gast einer rechtsextremen Rede (über 30 Jahre)
- Schüler/innen (18-23 Jahre)
- ⁠feste Freundinnen der rechtsextremen Gruppe (kaukasisch gelesen, deutschsprachig, 18-25 Jahre)
- ⁠Mutter mit Kopftuch (20-40 Jahre, migrantisch gelesen)
- ⁠Punk/ Person aus der alternativen Szene (über 18 Jahre)
- Kunden im Imbissladen
- ⁠…

*Infos und Kontakt:*

Dreh am 18.09.26 und 19.09.26 (du musst nicht beide Tage verfügbar sein)
Ort: Darmstadt und Umgebung

Da es sich um einen studentischen Abschlussfilm handelt, können wir leider keine Gage anbieten und auch keine Fahrtkosten übernehmen. Für Verpflegung am Set ist selbstverständlich gesorgt. Einige Rollen erfordern das Agieren in einem politisch sensiblen Kontext. Um die Ernsthaftigkeit des Themas darzustellen streben wir einen verantwortungsbewussten Umgang mit der Thematik an.

Bei Interesse meldet euch gerne mit ein paar Infos zu euch (Name, Alter, Wohnort, Kontakt) und idealerweise mit einem aktuellen Foto und/oder Showreel. Auch ohne vorherige Schauspielerfahrung könnt ihr euch gerne bewerben! Uns ist vor allem wichtig, dass ihr Lust auf das Projekt und die Rolle habt.
Unter folgender E-Mail Adresse sind wir zu erreichen:

casting.totenbuch@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf euch:))

- ⁠Schuldirektorin (über 35 Jahre)

- Besitzer eines Imbissladens (über 30 Jahre, migrantisch gelesen)

Kompars*innen

- ⁠Altfaschist/ Gast einer rechtsextremen Rede (über 30 Jahre)
- Schüler/innen (18-23 Jahre)
- ⁠feste Freundinnen der rechtsextremen Gruppe (kaukasisch gelesen, deutschsprachig, 18-25 Jahre)
- ⁠Mutter mit Kopftuch (20-40 Jahre, migrantisch gelesen)
- ⁠Punk/ Person aus der alternativen Szene (über 18 Jahre)
- Kunden im Imbissladen
- ⁠…

*Infos und Kontakt:*

Dreh am 18.09.26 und 19.09.26 (du musst nicht beide Tage verfügbar sein)
Ort: Darmstadt und Umgebung

Da es sich um einen studentischen Abschlussfilm handelt, können wir leider keine Gage anbieten und auch keine Fahrtkosten übernehmen. Für Verpflegung am Set ist selbstverständlich gesorgt. Einige Rollen erfordern das Agieren in einem politisch sensiblen Kontext. Um die Ernsthaftigkeit des Themas darzustellen streben wir einen verantwortungsbewussten Umgang mit der Thematik an.

Bei Interesse meldet euch gerne mit ein paar Infos zu euch (Name, Alter, Wohnort, Kontakt) und idealerweise mit einem aktuellen Foto und/oder Showreel. Auch ohne vorherige Schauspielerfahrung könnt ihr euch gerne bewerben! Uns ist vor allem wichtig, dass ihr Lust auf das Projekt und die Rolle habt.
Unter folgender E-Mail Adresse sind wir zu erreichen:

casting.totenbuch@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf euch:))

🎭**TICKETS NOW ON SALE!**

**LES MISÉRABLES – TWO-DAY MUSICAL THEATRE MASTERCLASS**

Ever wondered what it takes to perform at a professional West End level?

Now’s your chance to step into the world of Les Misérables and train with one of the theatre industry’s most experienced performers and directors.

🎤 Encore Event Management is delighted to present an exclusive two-day Musical Masterclass, directed by Andy Reiss — Resident Director of Les Misérables and Director of The Creative Masterclass: Les Misérables at Pineapple Studios, London.

**What to expect:**
* Work with iconic Les Misérables material
* Explore character, storytelling & script analysis
* Develop audition & performance techniques
* Learn what it takes to deliver eight professional shows a week
* Individual coaching & group work
* Personal feedback to help build confidence and sharpen your skills
* See your performance through the eyes of both a leading performer and a director

Andy’s masterclasses are so much more than a workshop — they’re an immersive, high-energy theatre experience designed to challenge, inspire and bring out the very best in every performer.

📅**THE WEEKEND**

Saturday | 9:30am – 5:00pm

Welcome, introduction & deep-dive rehearsals

Sunday | 9:30am – 4:00pm

Polishing sessions + optional final showcase for friends and family

£79 per person

**SPACES ARE LIMITED!**

If you’re passionate about musical theatre and want to take your performance skills to the next level, don’t miss this opportunity to learn from a true West End professional.

**BOOK YOUR PLACE NOW:**

[https://buytickets.at/encoreeventmanagement/2300830](https://buytickets.at/encoreeventmanagement/2300830)

Train. Perform. Discover what you’re capable of.

🎭**TICKETS NOW ON SALE!**

**LES MISÉRABLES – TWO-DAY MUSICAL THEATRE MASTERCLASS**

Ever wondered what it takes to perform at a professional West End level?

Now’s your chance to step into the world of Les Misérables and train with one of the theatre industry’s most experienced performers and directors.

🎤 Encore Event Management is delighted to present an exclusive two-day Musical Masterclass, directed by Andy Reiss — Resident Director of Les Misérables and Director of The Creative Masterclass: Les Misérables at Pineapple Studios, London.

**What to expect:**
* Work with iconic Les Misérables material
* Explore character, storytelling & script analysis
* Develop audition & performance techniques
* Learn what it takes to deliver eight professional shows a week
* Individual coaching & group work
* Personal feedback to help build confidence and sharpen your skills
* See your performance through the eyes of both a leading performer and a director

Andy’s masterclasses are so much more than a workshop — they’re an immersive, high-energy theatre experience designed to challenge, inspire and bring out the very best in every performer.

📅**THE WEEKEND**

Saturday | 9:30am – 5:00pm

Welcome, introduction & deep-dive rehearsals

Sunday | 9:30am – 4:00pm

Polishing sessions + optional final showcase for friends and family

£79 per person

**SPACES ARE LIMITED!**

If you’re passionate about musical theatre and want to take your performance skills to the next level, don’t miss this opportunity to learn from a true West End professional.

**BOOK YOUR PLACE NOW:**

[https://buytickets.at/encoreeventmanagement/2300830](https://buytickets.at/encoreeventmanagement/2300830)

Train. Perform. Discover what you’re capable of.

🎭 **AUDITION DATES ARE NOW OPEN IN SWINTON, MANCHESTER** 🎭

**Welcome to Marble Academy:**

**Where you receive a higher standard of acting training.**

If you possess a deep passion for acting and are committed to forging a professional career in the performance industry, you have found your ideal training ground. —welcome to 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲, where you turn: “𝐈’𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐜𝐭” into “𝐈’𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐫.”

 

Marble Academy is proud to be a **Spotlight-accredited drama school** and two-time consecutive winner of **‘Best Drama School Of The Year ’, **reflecting the high calibre of education and training provided here.  Designed to strip away bad habits and build strong, repeatable techniques for TV, Film, and Theatre.

Led directly by **Christian Le Feuvre**—a LAMDA-qualified actor and award-winning filmmaker—our tailored modules give you the practical skills needed to thrive in a competitive industry:
* 🎬 **Script Analysis & Characterisation:** Uncover deep subtext and embody characters authentically.
* 🎥 **Acting for Camera:** Master the subtle, intimate nuances required for screen performance.
* 🎭 **Audition Preparation:** Build the technical control and confidence required to walk into any audition room ready to impress.
* 📅 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
* 📍 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: Swinton, Manchester

🌐 **Explore Student Testimonials & Reserve Your Audition:** [www.marbleacademy.co.uk](http://www.marbleacademy.co.uk/)

 

So, stop wishing for opportunities and start equipping yourself to capture them. Take the leap, book your audition slot today.

 

𝐃𝐎𝐍’𝐓 𝐁𝐄 𝐀𝐍 𝐀𝐂𝐓𝐎𝐑 𝐁𝐄𝐂𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐄 𝐘𝐎𝐔 𝐖𝐀𝐍𝐓 𝐓𝐎; 𝐁𝐄 𝐀𝐍 𝐀𝐂𝐓𝐎𝐑 𝐁𝐄𝐂𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐄 𝐘𝐎𝐔 𝐇𝐀𝐕𝐄 𝐓𝐎!

🎭 **AUDITION DATES ARE NOW OPEN IN SWINTON, MANCHESTER** 🎭

**Welcome to Marble Academy:**

**Where you receive a higher standard of acting training.**

If you possess a deep passion for acting and are committed to forging a professional career in the performance industry, you have found your ideal training ground. —welcome to 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲, where you turn: “𝐈’𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐜𝐭” into “𝐈’𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐫.”

 

Marble Academy is proud to be a **Spotlight-accredited drama school** and two-time consecutive winner of **‘Best Drama School Of The Year ’, **reflecting the high calibre of education and training provided here.  Designed to strip away bad habits and build strong, repeatable techniques for TV, Film, and Theatre.

Led directly by **Christian Le Feuvre**—a LAMDA-qualified actor and award-winning filmmaker—our tailored modules give you the practical skills needed to thrive in a competitive industry:
* 🎬 **Script Analysis & Characterisation:** Uncover deep subtext and embody characters authentically.
* 🎥 **Acting for Camera:** Master the subtle, intimate nuances required for screen performance.
* 🎭 **Audition Preparation:** Build the technical control and confidence required to walk into any audition room ready to impress.
* 📅 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
* 📍 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: Swinton, Manchester

🌐 **Explore Student Testimonials & Reserve Your Audition:** [www.marbleacademy.co.uk](http://www.marbleacademy.co.uk/)

 

So, stop wishing for opportunities and start equipping yourself to capture them. Take the leap, book your audition slot today.

items.text: Hi! I just joined this group and have twin daughters that I usually have to fly to and from LA for all of their projects and would love for them to be able to participate and audition for local things to cut down on travel. But are the auditions on this site vetted in any way? It’s a little difficult for me to email pictures of my girls to strangers not knowing how legitimate the project is, but again, would love to have some local things that they can audition for.

topComments.text: I advise you to get representation from one of the local agents Big Fish or Radical would be my recommendation.
Always check IMDb for the people posting, if they are legit they will have stuff up there. It isn’t a guaranteed vet but it is a good way to find out to weed out some scams.

items.text:
Hello everyone! I am working on a suspense/mystery short film and looking to cast a few characters. This will be a low-budget, unpaid indie project with filming taking place towards the end of September and beginning of October.

Working Title: **A TALE BEFORE IT WAS **

On a rainy afternoon, Jane sits down to work on her new novel, but the story refuses to come together. Then a strange occurrence draws her into the woods, where she discovers secrets and mysteries that blur the line between fiction and reality. What begins as a potential idea for her next great novel may end up costing her far more than a story.

**JANE** – (20s/30s)

Lead character with some dialogue, along with voice-over narration. A quiet, isolated woman working on her new novel.

**COLE** – (30s/40s)

A father looking for his daughter. Minor role with dialogue.

**DAUGHTER** – (10–12 years old, or someone who can convincingly portray that age.)

Discovers a hidden mystery in the woods. Minor role with a little dialogue.

**HUSBAND** – One half of a couple looking to buy a new home. Small role with dialogue.

**WIFE**– The other half of the couple. Small role with dialogue.

**THE WAYFARER** – (6’0”+)

Looking for someone tall, slim, and with an average/slender build

The Wayfarer is a mysterious, death-like figure who lurks between the shadows and reveals himself when the time comes to claim his next soul. He moves between worlds and serves as a sort of ferryman between life and death.

An outfit will be provided for the character, along with light makeup designed to give the hands and face a frail, withered appearance.

**FILMING*****:***

We will be looking to film over a couple weekends at the end of September and beginning of October, with locations in the **Monument** area and **Wheat Ridge** area. There would be food, snacks, and beverages provided during filming.

This is an unpaid indie project being made by a small group of filmmakers who are passionate about creating something atmospheric and cinematic.

I'm hoping to meet other like-minded actors and filmmakers who are interested in collaborating and helping bring this story to life.

**If you’re interested in auditioning for a role or would like more information, please send me a message with the role you’re interested in!** Audition sides will be provided!

Thanks everyone, and I look forward to hearing from you!

CASTING CALL — VIDEO COMMERCIAL

Looking for an actor with strong comedic timing for a short commercial shoot for Uniti Wholesale.

The role, “Steve,” is an enthusiastic, slightly ridiculous character who takes a request for “fast” internet capacity a little too literally and transforms himself into a homemade Back to the Future-style mad scientist. The performance moves from thoughtful → wildly excited → confidently absurd → defeated.

Audition: Please send me a short selfie video performing:

“That’s it! We’re going back…to the future!”
“Great Scott! Great Scott! Great Scott!”
“Wonder if I can even get this thing up to 88 MPH…” 

Shoot date: September 3
Rate: $750
Location: Denver

URGENT CASTING – SOUTH OF FRANCE 
ENGLISH, AMERICAN, GERMAN & DUTCH MALE BACKGROUND EXTRAS – NATIVE SPEAKERS – apparent age 18 to 65
📍 CASSIS (13) – SEPTEMBER 7

(Priority will be given to actors. Please DO NOT apply via DM, and please make sure you REALLY read the entire casting notice carefully before applying 🙏🏻!)

Hello everyone,

For the filming of a mini-series for a streaming platform, I am looking for native ENGLISH, AMERICANS, GERMANS and DUTCH people to play party-going, drunken tourists staying at a trendy hotel club in Saint-Tropez in 2006.

SHOOTING DATE: MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 7
Estimated working hours: 2:00 PM – 12:00 AM

Please let me know whether you would be comfortable getting into/swimming in the pool.

For the ENGLISH, AMERICAN, GERMAN and DUTCH profiles, I am looking for all types: everyday/popular profiles as well as very upscale/luxury types, athletic people, models, trendy/cool profiles, younger profiles, etc.

Please do not apply if you do not work as an extra, and make sure to specify your availability/unavailability between SEPTEMBER 4 and SEPTEMBER 11.

🚗 TRANSPORTATION

For everyone: you MUST be able to make your own way to and from the filming location.

No travel expenses will be reimbursed. I am therefore looking for people who live near Cassis, or who are willing to travel there at their own expense.

⚠️ IMPORTANT – THE STORY TAKES PLACE IN 2006 so:

No overly enhanced/silicone-filled lips, no very sharply defined or block-shaped eyebrows, and no extremely long artificial nails.

No tattoos that look too recent/contemporary.
Tribal tattoos are fine.

💰 PAY

€98 gross flat-rate fee for 8h + 1h lunch break
 • possible overtime/night-hour supplements if applicable

There are no other shooting dates currently planned in the South of France, so please do not apply unless you are available during this period.

📩 HOW TO APPLY

If you are interested, available, match the criteria and DO NOT HAVE ANY TIME CONSTRAINTS on the day(s) you are applying for, please send your application to:

Uas.casting@gmail.com

⚠️ IMPORTANT – EMAIL SUBJECT LINE

Please make sure the SUBJECT LINE of your email includes:

the set/location + shooting date + your nationality/specific profile + age + FIRST NAME + LAST NAME + height + weight

For example:

“HOTEL SEPTEMBER 7 – AMERICAN – Bryan COX – 25 – 1.80m – 78kg”

or

“HOTEL SEPTEMBER 7 – GERMAN – Birgit WURST – 40 – 1.80m – 70kg – Mixed race”

etc… 

📋 YOUR APPLICATION SHOULD INCLUDE, IF POSSIBLE:
 • Your availability/unavailability between SEPTEMBER 4 and SEPTEMBER 11
 • Your FULL MEASUREMENTS: height, weight, jacket size, top size, trousers size, shoe size
 • Ethnic background
 • Eye color
 • Hair color
 • First name and last name (no stage names)
 • PHONE NUMBER
 • Date and place of birth
 • Place of residence (full address)
 • 2 to 3 recent photos of yourself, including a headshot, a full-length photo and a selfie taken today, without any filters
 • Please mention any hospitality/service experience or other specific skills/professional experience you may have (for example: police officer, etc.)
 • Please mention whether you have tattoos, piercings, dyed/colored hair, etc.
 • If you wish, please mention whether you have had cosmetic surgery
 • Please mention whether you own any very chic/upscale/luxury/gala outfits. Feel free to send photos of your outfits if possible!
 • Please mention whether you own any outfits that could be useful for potential upcoming scenes/sets (waiter/waitress, security staff, etc.). Feel free to include photos of yourself wearing them.
 • Please list all languages you speak, your level in each language, and any specific accents you may have
 • A CV/resume and showreel (if you have them), for my files and for potential featured-extra opportunities
 • Please mention any special skills or talents you may have: stunts, high-level sports, musician, dancer, etc.
 • Please confirm that you can travel independently to the filming location, and specify how: car, scooter, bicycle, e-scooter, etc.
 • If you have a car, please specify whether you would be willing to carpool
 • Please specify the brand and color of your car
 • Please include photos of your car, scooter, bicycle, etc., if applicable

Unfortunately, I won’t be able to reply to everyone, and I apologize in advance. I will contact you as soon as possible if your profile is suitable.

Thank you all in advance for your applications, and have a lovely day! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assisted by Angèle Chenais
Uas.casting@gmail.com

The Warehouse Arts Centre presents... 🔥The Warehouse Lab🔥

We’re looking for writers aged 18+ to submit work for a new Theatre Scratch Night at The Warehouse Art Centre.

It’s an opportunity to get your work on its feet, work with a director and actors, and see how it plays in front of a live audience.

We’re looking for:
-Short plays or scenes - up to 10 pages
-Monologues
-Spoken word pieces

Scratch night date: 1st of October 2026

Submit your work by: 17th of September 2026

Location: The Warehouse Arts Centre, Southport, 30 West St, Southport PR8 1QN

We’re open to new, unfinished or experimental work. Whether it’s funny, dark, strange, political or personal, we want to hear it.

Selected pieces will be paired with directors and actors and given three weeks to rehearse and develop the work before performing at the Scratch Night.

Head to the link on our Linktree (Found in our bio) to fill out a form and express your interest. If you would also like to perform your work please make us aware of this in the form. 

Get in touch! 

#scratchnight #theatre #writers

⭐️ Letzter CASTING AUFRUF ⭐️
Film-Casting für Kinder in Wien! 🎬🌟

Zweiter Casting Tag 🎥

Wir suchen nur mehr Buben! Du bist zwischen 8 und 10 Jahre alt und hast Lust, vor der Kamera zu stehen? Für einen Kurzfilm (Dreh: Herbst/Winter 2026 in Wien) sucht die Filmgruppe „Morgenlicht“ mindestens zwei Hauptdarsteller sowie mehrere Buben für eine Schulklasse.

• Wo? Volksschule Lange Gasse 36, 1080 Wien

• Wann? Freitag, 21.08.26

• Wer? Buben von 8–10 Jahren

• Wichtig: Teilnahme nur mit Voranmeldung!

Da wir allen Kindern ein entspanntes und stressfreies Casting bieten möchten, ist die Teilnehmerzahl begrenzt. Wenn alle Plätze voll sind, können wir leider keine Anmeldungen mehr annehmen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Für unser HFF-Sonderprojekt **„Arizona, Arizona“** suchen wir für den **02.09.2026** noch **männliche Kompars*innen zwischen ca. 25 und 70 Jahren**, die **LKW-Fahrer** spielen.

Gedreht wird im **Innenraum einer Gaststätte**. Das genaue Motiv geben wir noch bekannt. Wir fahren gemeinsam **von München aus zum Drehort**, eine eigene Anreise ist daher nicht notwendig.

Besonders freuen wir uns über Menschen, die selbst Erfahrung als LKW-Fahrer haben oder optisch gut in das Umfeld passen.

Da es sich um ein No-Budget-Hochschulprojekt handelt, können wir leider keine Gage zahlen. Für Verpflegung am Set ist gesorgt.

Bei Interesse meldet euch gerne mit einem kurzen Foto und ein paar Infos zu euch unter **helena.bublak@campus.hff-muc.de**.
